note: The shelf: every place this atlas draws, with the volumes recorded at it. Four things built it, and they are not the same kind of claim. (1) A snapshot of the Croatian shelf, imported once by scripts/import-defranceski.py from the Defranceschi Archive's researchmap.json — walked parish by parish by hand. Progress state was dropped on the way in and access was re-derived; a stranger's question is not the researcher's question. (2) Ground from the six sibling archives, by scripts/import-archives.py — places, coordinates and name variants only, never people. (3) Places a FamilySearch collection names outright, by scripts/promote-collection-places.py: a collection catalogued under a town is a statement that registers for that town exist, which is what a shelf entry is. (4) The world's own filing units — every first-level administrative division, and the second-level ones a collection names — by scripts/promote-admin-divisions.py out of data/admin-divisions.json. These carry no volumes and are drawn hollow. A place's `region` is NOT stored here: it is decided against the rings on every build, because a stored one goes stale the moment a region is added.
